name: Zoom
description: Zoom/: ViewZoom, the suite's one zoom model (#5070): ZoomSteps (the 10% to 3200% clamp, Zoom In and Zoom Out over the suite's stops or an app's own table, the snap that lands a pinch near 100% on 100%, the fit scale, the anchor that keeps the point under the pointer still, the percent text), ZoomLevel (fit, 100% or a scale; fit follows the viewport) and ZoomKey (Command-plus, minus, 0 and 1). SuiteUI's ZoomMath, ViewerZoom and CanvasViewport wrap it; Flare's stage and Library's loupe step their own tables on it.
